name: Matylda Jedynak

name: Arash Karimi

name: Jacek Kacprzyk

name: Marzena Cichocka

name: Robert Gawroński
style: Writes from the road between schools. Tells what the teachers said in the training.

name: Barbara Ziółkowska
style: Academic Polish, long sentences with research words (grupa kontrolna, pretest, posttest).

name: Patryk Szostak

name: Nina Woźnicka
style: Unsure, apologizes for the question, often ends with an emoji.

name: Wiktoria Sobolewska

name: Olena Kovalenko

name: Teresa Wróblewska

name: Norbert Szulc

name: Ksenia Borowska
role: Laboratory technician on the night shift

name: Leszek Nowakowski
style: Impatient radiologist. Abbreviations (TK, MR, USG, opis), no greetings, writes between examinations.

name: Iwona Stachowiak
style: Tells step by step what happened at the device. Does not know issue keys and describes the issue in words.

name: Erik Johansson
style: English with a few Polish words that he knows (dziękuję, proszę, dzień dobry).

name: Arkadiusz Mikulski
role: Head of IT of all clinics
style: Talks about plans and budgets. Names the clinic by its district (Mokotów, Wola, Ursynów).

name: Tadeusz Wrona

name: Dominika Ryba
style: Passes on what the staff said, with their words in quotes. Kind and a little chaotic.

name: Stanisław Góral

name: Grażyna Pietruszka
style: Calm and exact. Names the NFZ deadlines and the codes of the services.

name: Jakub Sowiński
style: Asks with numbers and percentages. Uses English data words (dashboard, query, outlier).

name: Sławomir Kubicki

name: Lidia Banaś
style: Technical and exact. Gives numbers of seconds, queues and lines.

name: Krystian Wilczyński
style: Young and cocky. Slang ('ziom', 'sztos'), brags about his sales, then gives the request.

name: Jolanta Kurzawa

name: Remigiusz Fabiański
style: Short business messages about deals, prices of the lists and partners.

name: Sandra Kozieł
style: Excel words and percentages: konwersja, kolumna, filtr.

name: Dariusz Oleksy

name: Kinga Rataj

name: Hieronim Bąkowski
style: Old-fashioned and very polite. Long sentences, 'uprzejmie proszę', stories from his calls.

name: Aneta Zych
style: Calendar style: dates, hours and the names of villages and towns.

name: Grzegorz Lenart

name: Teodora Wasiak

name: Urszula Strzelecka

name: Kamila Pyka

name: Ryszard Majchrzak

name: Oleksandr Bondarenko
role: Tech lead of the AI agent

name: Iryna Melnyk
style: Quotes what the pilot customers said. Sometimes adds a Ukrainian word such as 'diakuju' at the end.

name: Kornelia Sęk
style: Short bug report style: what happened, what she expected, then the request.

name: Yuliia Marchenko

name: Hubert Kałuża

name: Nataliia Lysenko

name: Oksana Savchuk

name: Wiesława Gąsior

name: Dmytro Kravets
style: English technical words, very short lines, often writes about night deployments.

name: Serhii Polishchuk
style: Polish without Polish letters. Many questions, but one clear request.

name: Anastasiia Klymenko
style: Talks about the cost of tokens and the names of the models.
